title: Admit the digest-closed Foundation-01 semantic cohort

artifact_type.representation_note: The decision record format remains a local bootstrap candidate; authority comes from the exact human token bound here, not from self-admission of the format.

admissibility.ordering_limitation: The user selected the exact FOUNDATION-01-ADMIT token before this durable four-option prefilter request and receipt were materialized. The receipt proves structural admissibility and does not claim that every receipt option label was displayed before selection.

selection.rationale: Admit the minimum coherent semantic foundation needed to author and evaluate canonical Lab Definitions while preserving role separation and excluding Definition/v1 itself and every runtime, implementation, publication, and stable-version claim.

bootstrap_owner_identity.basis: Exact candidate-authoring authorization followed by this exact manifest-and-receipt-bound admission token.
bootstrap_owner_identity.effect: Admit the owner registry and its five separate role assignments as the Foundation-01 bootstrap authority map.
bootstrap_owner_identity.non_effect: A shared principal does not collapse the five role scopes or allow a determination under one role to satisfy another role automatically.

role_scoped_determinations.effect: Admit the machine-canonical and generated-human-projection direction, closed schema bindings, and projection contracts for the admitted Foundation-01 surfaces.
role_scoped_determinations.non_effect: The candidate renderer and validator are accepted as evidence-producing bytes only; they are not admitted tools, runtimes, enforcement points, or implementation bindings.

role_scoped_determinations.effect: Admit Artifact Type/v1 as the bootstrap type root and activate exactly the eight listed artifact-type references.
role_scoped_determinations.non_effect: Registration of cal.artifact-type.definition/v1 remains visible in the root candidate but is not activated or admitted by this decision.

role_scoped_determinations.effect: Admit the Definition lifecycle profile and the empty canonical Definition registry with its generated index contract.
role_scoped_determinations.non_effect: No Definition instance, including the term Definition, enters the registry and Definition/v1 remains a candidate artifact type.

role_scoped_determinations.effect: Admit only the three exact selector digests for their individually stated target uses.
role_scoped_determinations.non_effect: The legacy identifiers, statuses, full source file, and any broader semantic or enforcement authority are not imported.

role_scoped_determinations.effect: Admit the Definition evaluation profile and drift-audit contract, and accept the bound 28-check PASS as cohort-coherence evidence.
role_scoped_determinations.non_effect: Validation evidence neither performs admission nor proves semantic truth, implementation conformance, or D65 completion.

source_admissions.target_use: Evidence for the Four-Facet Artifact Invariant and artifact mechanics only.
Evidence for the revised Lab Definition semantics and three-voice contract.
Evidence for separating artifact type, canonical representation, origin, and authority.

definition_authority_state.required_next_audit: Refresh the drift audit against this admission decision before any Definition promotion; the old sources-pending finding is resolved by this decision while the undefined Definition finding remains open.

generated_projection_posture.policy: Human views are generated projections and never independent authority.
generated_projection_posture.accepted_parity_evidence: The bound Foundation-01 receipt reports deterministic two-run generation and exact projection parity.

admission_result.effect: Artifact Type/v1, seven supporting artifact types, the exact profiles, owner map, source admissions, empty Definition authority surface, drift contract, schemas, and Foundation manifest are admitted under the role-scoped clauses above.

excluded_effects: cal.artifact-type.definition/v1 and its existing artifact.json remain candidate-unadmitted; this decision does not activate the Definition artifact type.
No Definition instance is admitted, and the critical term Definition remains absent from the canonical registry.
The pre-admission drift snapshot is not represented as a current post-admission audit; it must be refreshed before Definition promotion.
Foundation render.py, validate.py, and all other tooling are not admitted runtimes, trusted enforcement points, implementations, or implementation bindings.
The PASS receipt is accepted only as candidate-coherence evidence and does not itself grant authority or conformance.
No Product Capability, capability-local business ontology, Craft or DomainSpec authored source, compiled graph, system ontology, exact implementation binding, or conformance evidence is established.
No Git commit, push, publication, release, deployment, external effect, or first stable version is authorized or performed.
successor_obligations: Generate a fresh Definition drift-audit postimage that cites this decision and preserves the unresolved undefined-Definition blocker.
Revise Definition/v1 into a new digest-bound candidate epoch so its bootstrap-predecessor residue points to this admitted Foundation-01 decision rather than a missing future decision.
Author the Definition term as a Definition/v1 candidate with formal, plain-language, and CyberAlchemy Lab domain-context voices.
Validate the Definition candidate with synchronized registry, index, and drift-audit postimages, then request a separate exact owner promotion decision.
Treat Product Capability and every later CAV2-D65 stage as separate missing work; do not infer them from this admission.
